messages:
emma: Quick thought — for the webinar registrants we should stagger the launch newsletter sends by engagement cohort + local TZ. Want to avoid crowded inboxes and optimize open rate.
raj: agree. can we do 3 cohorts? high-engage, warm, cold.
olivia: yes. high-engage = attended past webinar or clicked >2 emails in last 30d. warm = opened 1-2. cold = not opened.
mateo: timeline? we have launch announcement going out Friday at 10am PDT to general list.
emma: plan: Fri 10am PDT -> global broadcast (short announce). Next week do tailored follow-ups to registrants: high-engage Mon, warm Tue, cold Thu. shift per tz so local morning.
raj: how do we compute local morning? use tz on user profile then map to 9am local? fallback to IP-based region for missing.
olivia: segment query draft: ```SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE registered_for_webinar AND engagement_score >= 8``` then join with timezone table. Need someone to QA.
emma: @mateo can you QA the SQL and make sure we don't overlap with the product launch audience? we can't email duplicates. :pray:
mateo: on it. I'll run a dedupe step: left_join exclude anyone in product_launch_table. I'll post counts by cohort.
marketing-bot: scheduled job created: `cohort-send-check-1993056789` — will post cohort sizes after run.
mateo: counts after dry-run: high 1,240; warm 3,870; cold 9,512. Total 14,622.
olivia: those cold numbers feel high. can we prune by last_active < 365 days? otherwise deliverability risk.
emma: good call. apply last_active < 365 filter and remove suppressed list.
raj: cadence notes: creative for high-engage can be heavy on CTA (register/early access), warm should be value-first, cold should be re-opt-in + short.
emma: subject line tests: high: "You're on the VIP list — webinar seats limited"; warm: "Quick reminder: live webinar + benchmark reveals"; cold: "See what teams are doing with Redwood Inference". A/B the warm subject with an urgency variant.
mateo: I'll add UTM params for all links and ensure tracking keys map to campaign=webinar_q2_launch.
olivia: can design do 3 variants? put plain text fallback for cold cohort. @design-team please?
emma: tagging design in main channel. final ask: can we schedule staging sends for small samplings (200 each) next Wednesday to check render + link click paths?
raj: yep. target sample: 200 from each cohort, across different mail clients. I'll coordinate with ops for seed emails.
marketing-bot: reminder set: "staging-send-check" Wednesday 09:00 UTC.
emma: perfect. after staging we iterate subject and send windows. thanks team :rocket:
